outcomes_permitted.IMPROVEMENT_MEASURED: candidate outperforms baseline on at least one measured metric under identical harness · both values reported · no synthetic percent

outcomes_permitted.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: attempted but insufficient signal (fewer than N samples · non-deterministic harness · missing environment fingerprint)
outcomes_permitted.INCONCLUSIVE: measurement attempted but signal is insufficient to conclude
